payload.explanation: The business request (session_9c794be1dd06, pid 431) is blocked on a transactionid lock while running UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1. pg_blocking_pids identifies pid 432 (session_c813da25ab61) as the root blocker: it executed the same UPDATE earlier (query_stats shows one call, rows=1) and is now 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead, holding its row lock uncommitted. Two other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_b9cdfc2a2923, session_b673cc9a55ad) ran only SELECT 1 and are not in the blocking chain. Indexes are minimal (PK only), no vacuum/bloat signals, so no evidence for INSERT_LARGE_DATA, FETCH_LARGE_DATA, REDUNDANT_INDEX, or VACUUM. Remediation: roll back the eligible blocker session to release the lock, preserving the business request. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed.
